shorterRoute: Adapt the already proved original finite-field-of-definition argument to the exact Gamma1 integral-ratio field. Reuse finite separating-coordinate support and residue fields to bound place orbits, finite support to fix Picard classes, the exact Tate projection kernel, and the existing period base-change finite generation. Derive open stabilizers of the finite dual; no new topological Tate theory or general scheme descent is needed.

Reuse the already proved faithful open-kernel fixed-field construction. Actual Tate-dual continuity supplies the open kernel; the group-source representation takes values in units automatically. Retain the faithful factor needed by the existing original arithmetic-descent theorem instead of rebuilding finite Galois or ramification foundations.
assumptionsToDischarge: Derive finite fields of definition for the exact Gamma1 functions, places and Picard classes; hence their actual stabilizers are open.
Reuse the exact Tate projection kernel and original period basis to obtain open uniform congruences.
Prove finiteness of the actual homogeneous-valued Tate dual and its factorization through the indicated torsion coordinate.
Derive continuity of its genuine global Galois action and apply the native faithful finite fixed-field theorem. No geometric degree/genus assumption is needed for these continuity conclusions.
